Hegseth’s Pentagon Accuses Canada of Failing as Credible Defense Partner Amid Tensions

The Pentagon has accused Canada of falling short as a credible partner in defending North America, escalating tensions between the neighboring countries amid an ongoing trade war . In a two-page fact sheet released Monday, the Pentagon under Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth outlined what it described as Canada's “defense shortfalls,” issuing a sharp rebuke of the country's leadership under Prime Minister Mark Carney .
